posts.title: 5 Tips for Hair Care This Summer
posts.excerpt: Heat and humidity can damage your hair. With these 5 simple tips, keep your mane healthy and shiny all summer long.
posts.author: Magnolia Peluquería
posts.content:
# 5 Tips for Hair Care This Summer

Summer means sun, beach, and pool — but also hair damage if we don't take proper precautions. Here are 5 simple tips to keep your hair healthy.

## 1. Weekly Deep Hydration

After sun exposure, apply a hydrating mask for at least 15 minutes. Look for products with keratin, argan oil, or coconut. They seal moisture and restore natural shine.

## 2. UV Protection for Hair

Just like your skin, your hair needs sun protection. Use sprays or creams with UV filters specifically for hair. Apply before going out and reapply every 2 hours outdoors.

## 3. Cold Water Rinse

Cold water seals the hair cuticle, locking in shine and preventing moisture loss. A simple habit that makes a real difference.

## 4. Reduce Hot Tools

Blow dryers, flat irons, and curling irons are even more damaging in summer. Let your hair air dry when possible. When you must use tools, always apply heat protection.

## 5. Regular Salon Visits

A regular trim (every 6-8 weeks) removes split ends before they spread. In summer, also ask your stylist about reconstructive treatments.

posts.title: Hair Colors That Will Trend in 2026
posts.excerpt: From warm caramel tones to intense auburn. Discover the hair colors that will dominate 2026 and how to choose the ideal one for your skin tone.
posts.author: Magnolia Peluquería
posts.content:
# Hair Colors That Will Trend in 2026

The world of hair coloration is constantly evolving. Here are the trends that will dominate 2026.

## 1. Balayage 'Caramel Glaze'

Balayage continues to lead. In 2026 it features warm caramel and honey tones. Perfect for those seeking a natural change without excessive maintenance.

## 2. Intense Auburn

Auburn — a reddish-brown with copper highlights — suits warm skin tones and green or amber eyes. It's luminous without being over the top.

## 3. Onyx with Blue Highlights

For the boldest, black with blue or violet undertones offers a sophisticated, modern touch.

## 4. Pearl Blonde

Ash blonde continues to trend. Cooler than golden blonde, it provides luminosity without looking artificial. Ideal for fair skin with cool undertones.

## 5. Honey Blonde

An intermediate tone between golden and ash, with golden highlights that catch the light. Versatile and flattering on almost all skin tones.

posts.title: Keratin: Yes or No? Everything You Need to Know
posts.excerpt: Keratin is one of the most popular and controversial treatments. We separate science from myth so you can make the best decision for your hair.
posts.author: Magnolia Peluquería
posts.content:
# Keratin: Yes or No? Everything You Need to Know

Keratin has become an everywhere term in every hair salon. But do you really understand what it is, how it works, and its limitations?

## What is Keratin?

Keratin is a natural protein present in hair. Keratin treatments supplement this protein, filling gaps in the cuticle. The result: smoother, shinier, more manageable hair.

## Types of Keratin

- **Formaldehyde (banned in many countries):** Most aggressive. Smoothes a lot but releases formaldehyde, a carcinogen. Avoid.
- **Formaldehyde-free / natural keratin:** Better option. Uses ingredients like cysteine, hydrolyzed keratin, or silk amino acids.
- **Nanokeratin:** Lighter form that penetrates the hair fiber better.

## Who is it For?

Keratin works best for frizzy, very curly hair that doesn't respond to conventional products. Not necessary for 이미 smooth or very fine hair.

## How Long Does it Last?

3-6 months depending on the treatment type. After that period, hair returns to its natural state without additional damage.
